reviewer: Codex: localized first-use outlines, fictional sources and rendered native memo review
review_scope: Prepared local documentary INPS review only. All ten native memos were rendered and all twenty pages inspected, together with the localized document requests, guides and source inputs. Regression model interpretations and scope confirmations are test-only. This review does not certify a legal conclusion, live research, portal access, voice behavior, professional approval or learner understanding.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The plain case-review title and Marta employment example introduce the whole documentary route: state the question, supply documents, inspect a source-linked draft and continue with a later record. The subject is ordinary contribution-record review rather than a pension calculation or a special technical feature.
editorial.inputs_and_request: Read the localized case question, employer statement, record-context note and period CSV. Together they identify Marta, Riva Servizi and January-June 2025. Each source is explicitly fictional. The natural request is usable without knowing the internal schema and identifies the official-source check needed during a live run.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The current inventory, factual evidence validation and packaging commands produce the actual memo and requests. Checkpoints ask the learner to state the question and trace a fact to its source and next clarification. The teaching voice follows the working chat results. The native test uses fixed, explicitly synthetic interpretations; it does not test live voice or human confirmation.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: The two-page Word memo has a descriptive title, readable source-linked facts and chronology, and a distinction between what the employer declares and what the fictional record lists. Fixed headings, status wording and document requests follow the lesson language. The next step is obtaining the complete official record and relevant employment evidence; neither an omission nor an updated record is presented as proof of payment or non-payment.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: The practice uses a new dated record covering the complete employment period. Its memo changes the observation and requests clarification of the update without inventing its timing or cause. The lesson directs the learner to preserve the first dossier and compare the two, then explains how to start a new real case with question, period, people and available documents.
editorial.language_and_pacing: Read the it guide, source inputs, document requests and rendered memo pages. Localized prose remains faithful to the same bounded case. Source CSV field names and audit identifiers remain technical labels. The six outline stages total 390 seconds; live source research, processing and questions may extend elapsed time. All twenty memo pages have no clipped text or literal Markdown emphasis markers.

The public-source statements are fixed regression inputs inspected during authoring, not fresh live research evidence.

freshness_review.content_review: Reconstructing the accepted course with its preserved source list matches its exact prior SHA-256. The localized lesson content, fictional file definitions, checkpoints and practice are unchanged. I reviewed the shared footer diff: French and German wording now uses the same formal address as the lesson. I also reviewed the reporting-table diff: it changes fixed translated labels and number punctuation, not values, signs or scales. No other pinned Python or JavaScript execution source in this kit references reporting_table. The original artifact reviews and their stated limitations are retained; this is not a new independent or learner review.
freshness_review.execution_review: Every supported locale and both phases have successful native test cases with the current canonical course fingerprint. The evidence collection retains actual case outputs from runs 39, 40, 41 and 43 and resolves every prior failure; it is not presented as a new test run or remote CI status.

interim_release_refresh.content_review: Compared the complete course object against the preserved reviewed commit: every authored locale, input, exercise, checkpoint and lesson duration is unchanged. Only installed source bindings changed. Original named editorial and artifact reviews remain preserved below; this is a bounded release refresh, not a new independent review.
interim_release_refresh.source_review: Integrated published main through 07689c38: optional onboarding does not block ordinary work; current Clara case, evidence, deck and delivery contracts are preserved; the current bank PDF-table adapter retains reviewed source mappings. Mixed-format changes add the original legacy renderer and prepared-file fingerprints. Reviewed local display and handoff differences against the prior source; no new lesson or professional approval is introduced.
